Use static and dynamic analysis tools to scan for SQL queries constructed with unsanitized user input, particularly in ORDER BY clauses. Check for session cookies (OSTSESSID) that are not regenerated on login by tracking session IDs before and after authentication. Inspect uploaded SVG/XML files in the file_uploads directory for embedded <script> tags and ensure they are not served with executable content types. Correlate web server logs for suspicious access patterns to these files and endpoints.
